LanguageData.APM_Weapon_DuelistsPsySpear.label: dominion psy-spear
LanguageData.APM_Weapon_DuelistsPsySpear.description: A reinforced spear imbued with Dominus-derived psychic circuitry. Allows the wielder to challenge a single opponent into a psychic duel, creating a focused maelstrom that amplifies attacks within. The spear channels the wielder’s will, projecting a shield around the duel and enhancing damage output within the duel’s radius.
